meta.description: Read, write, and convert multiple sequence alignment files using Biopython Bio.AlignIO. Supports Clustal, PHYLIP, Stockholm, FASTA, Nexus, and other alignment formats for phylogenetics and conservation analysis. Use when reading, writing, or converting alignment file formats.
meta.execution_note: First audit. Mode A (agent follows SKILL.md patterns; shipped examples also run from a copy). All 7 inputs executed. Windows venv Biopython 1.88, pyhmmer 0.12.3, numpy 2.0.2; WSL env alignment for MAFFT 7.526, HMMER 3.4, PAML 4.10.10, Foldmason 4.dd3c235; WSL env bio for HH-suite reformat.pl and IQ-TREE 3.1.3. Real data: Pfam PF00042 seed (73x141), 8 UniProt globins, 6 RefSeq HBB CDS, 3 PDB structures. SYNTHETIC data (labelled in scripts): 4-seq DNA Clustal shipped by the Skill, an RNA Stockholm with GS/GR/GC lines, a 200-nt genome with a hand-built MAF (ground truth for the strand test), PSL/chain/padded-A2M one-liners, PHYLIP name-collision alignment. Judged by asserted output content, not exit codes. IQ-TREE 2 (iqtree2) not installed; only IQ-TREE 3.1.3 tested. Pfam-A.full streaming not exercised (3 concatenated seed copies stand in).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers, statistics or clinical claims; every value the Skill states about formats was checked against Biopython 1.88 (several are inaccurate but none is invented data).

practice_boundaries.detail: File-format Skill; no diagnostic, prescriptive or patient-level content in any of the 7 outputs.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled methodological fallacy; the MAF strand helper is a silent implementation defect (recorded as P1), not a methodological baseline error.

code_usability.detail: Core AlignIO/Bio.Align snippets, batch/slice/convert patterns and the codeml route ran and were asserted. The pyhmmer streaming snippet raises AttributeError on pyhmmer 0.12.3 and convert_formats.py raises ValueError on NEXUS; both are adaptable one-line fixes under the Skill's own 'introspect and adapt' instruction and are recorded as P1, not as unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Core AlignIO read/write/convert/slice work and the Common Errors table is accurate, but the MAF helper is silently wrong, the pyhmmer snippet raises AttributeError, Bio.Align (the recommended API) fails on real Pfam Stockholm, and the coverage/not-in-Biopython tables are stale for PSL, chain, A2M, MSF, A3M.

reliability.note: Errors are documented accurately; shipped examples give a raw traceback and leave a 0-byte output.nex; batch_convert silently converts nothing; slice_alignment silently writes empty columns.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md ~330 lines, single file; niche sections (MAF, A3M, Pfam streaming) always loaded; usage-guide repeats the format table and tips.

agent_usability.note: Goal/Approach pattern and version-check note are clear; inconsistent recommendation (Bio.Align 'modern') vs every example using AlignIO; strand '+'/'-' string vs int; no output-verification guidance beyond one invalid IQ-TREE command.

human_usability.note: Description and example prompts use natural language; no guidance for an unspecified or mislabelled input format.

security.note: No credentials, eval or network use; user-supplied paths are used unvalidated; batch_convert overwrites converted/ without notice.

maintainability.note: SKILL.md, usage-guide and five example files are separated, but usage-guide duplicates SKILL.md; three of four runnable examples cannot run from a clean copy (missing inputs), and version-sensitive claims (pyhmmer API, Bio.Align formats) are unpinned.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger; Related Skills and cross-refs (msa-parsing/examples/neff.py) exist; no references/ dir; escape-hatch table is partly wrong (PSL, chain); re-runs safe but batch no-op is silent.

key_strengths: Core AlignIO read/write/convert/slice/parse-multiple patterns all work and round-trip real Pfam data with identical ids and residues (asserted).
PHYLIP advice (use phylip-relaxed, sanitise names, sequential for PAML) was verified end to end with a real IQ-TREE 3.1.3 run and real codeml (omega 0.28303).
Common Errors table reproduces exactly in Biopython 1.88, and A3M/reformat.pl match-state guidance is correct on real HH-suite output.
Good coverage of hazards other Skills omit: annotation loss on conversion, MAF strand coordinates, A3M reference-sequence choice, Pfam id convention.

recommendations.title: maf_to_plus_strand_coords is silently wrong for minus strand
recommendations.problem: Biopython 1.88 returns MAF strand as int (+1/-1); the SKILL helper tests `== '-'`, so minus-strand rows are returned unconverted (66 vs true 60 on a synthetic genome) and land on the wrong locus with no error.
recommendations.root_cause: Helper written against the MAF text spec, not against what AlignIO.parse(..., 'maf') stores.
recommendations.fix: Test `row_anno['strand'] in ('-', -1)` (or `== -1`), state that the strand annotation is an int, and add a one-line ground-truth check (revcomp of contig[plus_start:plus_start+size] equals the ungapped row).

recommendations.title: Shipped examples do not run from a clean copy; canonical convert crashes
recommendations.problem: convert_formats.py raises ValueError (molecule type) at the NEXUS write on the shipped sample and real Pfam, leaving a 0-byte output.nex; convert_formats.py and slice_alignment.py need an unshipped alignment.aln; batch_convert.py exits 0 having converted nothing; slice_alignment.py writes 0-column FASTA on the 21-column sample.
recommendations.root_cause: Examples were not executed against the shipped data; Clustal reader sets no molecule_type, which NEXUS output requires.
recommendations.fix: Point the examples at sample_alignment.aln (or ship the files they read), set record.annotations['molecule_type'] (or use AlignIO.convert(..., molecule_type=...)) before the NEXUS write, fail loudly when the input dir has no matches, and guard slice bounds against the alignment size.

recommendations.title: pyhmmer streaming snippet and A3M/A2M claims do not match pyhmmer 0.12.3 / HMMER
recommendations.problem: msa.nseq and msa.alen do not exist (AttributeError) and msa.name is str, not bytes; pyhmmer has no 'a3m' format although the table says A2M/A3M R/W; real hmmalign A2M output is ragged (no '.' padding), so 'A2M loads as a rectangular MSA' is false for it.
recommendations.root_cause: API and format claims were written from memory and not run against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Use len(msa.sequences), len(msa.alignment[0]) and msa.name (str), drop A3M from the pyhmmer column, state that padded A2M comes from HH-suite reformat.pl and that HMMER a2m may need match-state extraction per row (verified: uppercase/'-' filter gives 117 = model length), and record the pyhmmer version tested.

recommendations.title: Bio.Align recommended as modern API but fails on real Stockholm; format tables stale
recommendations.problem: Align.read/parse('stockholm') raises TypeError on the real Pfam seed and Align.write('stockholm') raises AttributeError on a FASTA-read Alignment, yet the SKILL recommends Bio.Align for new code. The 'NOT in BioPython' table lists PSL and chain, which Bio.Align 1.88 parses; A2M and MSF are marked unsupported though both exist.
recommendations.root_cause: Tables and recommendation were not checked against Biopython 1.88.
recommendations.fix: Recommend AlignIO for Stockholm until Bio.Align handles Pfam per-residue annotations, add the observed failure to Common Errors, and correct the format tables (Bio.Align.formats lists a2m, chain, msf, psl).

recommendations.title: PHYLIP guidance overstated or incomplete
recommendations.problem: Strict PHYLIP write of colliding 10-char names raises ValueError (not silent); ':' in names is rewritten to '|' by the writer; phylip-sequential for PAML fails for real NCBI headers and the SKILL never says to shorten ids first; 'iqtree2 -s file.phy --check' is not a valid IQ-TREE option.
recommendations.root_cause: Claims were not reproduced with Biopython 1.88 and IQ-TREE.
recommendations.fix: Say the write fails loudly and silence occurs when reading foreign strict files; add 'shorten ids to <=10 unique characters before phylip-sequential'; replace --check with a real validation such as a short iqtree run (`-n 0 -m LG`) or a Biopython re-read.

recommendations.title: Pfam id / GF metadata statements inaccurate
recommendations.problem: Biopython already fills record.annotations['start'/'end'/'accession'] from name/start-end (only the id keeps the suffix); AlignIO drops #=GF header lines (ID, AC, DE) on Stockholm round trip, contradicting 'Stockholm preserves annotations'.
recommendations.root_cause: Annotation-preservation table written without a round-trip test on a real Pfam file.
recommendations.fix: Correct the Pfam id paragraph and list #=GF header lines as not preserved by AlignIO on read.

recommendations.title: usage-guide.md duplicates SKILL.md; no references/ layer
recommendations.problem: The format-selection table and PHYLIP/Stockholm tips appear in both files.
recommendations.fix: Keep the table and tips in one place (SKILL.md) and let usage-guide.md carry only prompts and prerequisites.
